excluded_root_directories..git: Version-control object database; not a distribution input
excluded_root_directories..cache: External tool/model/download cache; never packaged or used by native CI
excluded_root_directories.target: Build staging; release artifacts require the separate artifact scan
excluded_root_directories..agents: Environment-owned agent configuration; not a distribution input
excluded_root_directories..codex: Environment-owned agent configuration; not a distribution input

notes: Only root resources descendants are a textual policy exception. Ignored authored docs are scanned.
Exclusions classify external caches and build staging, never shipped text or optional execution integrations.

Source legal notices remain under the resources boundary. Artifact scans accept only exact-path, byte-identical files from the source-controlled legal payload; additional/modified files receive ordinary checks. Original legal notices must never be stripped. Relocated immutable vocabularies retain their original digests.
Release packages and controlled binary strings must be supplied with --artifact; ordinary source success does not certify a release bundle.
